title: Tampa's Cigar City Bus Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Tampa Minibus Tours is ready to take you for a taste of the Cigar Capital of the World. Come aboard our 12 passenger air-conditioned minibus where you experience the many cigar lounge flavors that Tampa has to offer. From cathedrals to rooftops to hand-rollers to tasty spirits to Cuban coffee. This 3.5 hour tour embodies it all. Tourists will also learn the unique history and culture of Ybor City all while passing by this areas very 1st cigar factory. You'll also have the opportunity to pass by and learn about the only remaining operating cigar factory in Ybor City called the J.C. Newman Cigar Company.
